newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.591 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.591 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended January 4 was 4,591,917 gallons compared with 3,628,740 gallons last week.
Imports were 459,065 gallons compared with 443,679 gallons the previous week. There were 14,713 domestic receipts this week versus 22,528 domestic receipts the previous week.
Retail movement was 990,039 gallons, with bulk movement of 3,302,850 gallons. Current season cumulative movement was 23,209,189 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 69,755,159 gallons.
